text:
Situation: Gentamicin sulfate is not on FDA's current shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 31 vials of 40 mg/mL, 2 mL at 15.3 per day: 2 days on hand. Corvale General holds 244 vials at 16.3 per day: 15 days on hand. Other sites have adequate stock.

Why (FDA record): FDA's history shows an earlier shortage first posted on 2021-07-23, since resolved. FDA inspection 1110899 at Hospira, Inc. (FEI 1021343) ended 2019-11-21, classified VAI; classification letter 2020-02-12 — 610 days before FDA posted the shortage on 2021-07-23. FDA inspection 1210546 at Cosette Pharmaceuticals NC Laboratories, LLC (FEI 1053439) ended 2023-07-21, classified VAI; classification letter 2023-08-25 — 728 days after FDA posted the shortage on 2021-07-23. Our NDC 00409120703 is labeled by Hospira, Inc., which names Hospira, Inc. as a registered plant (FEI 1021343) last inspected NAI 2025-02-07.

Our position: No national shortage exists per FDA. The risk is local at Corvale East. Corvale General can spare inventory without dropping below two weeks.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 16 vials of 40 mg/mL, 2 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Buy from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC — approved by buyer.
3. Buy from Baxter Healthcare Corporation — approved by buyer.
4. Buy from Eugia US LLC — approved by buyer.
5. Use same molecule, alternate concentration or vial size: GENTAMICIN SULFATE 40 mg/mL from Hospira, Inc. — approved by pharmacist.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes; those are for treating clinicians and the committee.
